name: research
description: Bounded factual investigation or decision research — no implementation
when: Investigating a non-trivial fact, writing an Architecture Decision Record (ADR), or evaluating material alternatives before delivery

roles.whenNeeded: user explicitly requests an execution plan

notes: A bounded factual investigation defaults to the analyst only; an explicitly user-named role or narrower factual domain specialist remains valid. Add architect for a decision, ADR, or material alternatives. Add planner only when the user explicitly requests an execution plan. Recovery is needed only for continuation. No implementation or QA.
